primary_endpoint: Percent of participants with treatment-emergent adverse events, serious adverse events, and grade 3 or higher laboratory abnormalities; follow-up varied by cohort (8, 12, or 26 weeks, plus 30 days).
safety_signal: Treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in 25–87.5% of participants across cohorts; serious adverse events in 0–10%. Grade 3 or higher laboratory abnormalities ranged from 6.7% to 40% among cohorts with reported values; Cohort 13's value is incomplete in the source.
